parsed.summary: Every explicitly specified item matches the drawing: XT60-M input, 10 mΩ (R1=0.01) shunt with INA219 at 0x40, MIC26903 buck with L1=15uH and R5=6k8/R6=1k3 giving Vout=0.8*(1+R5/R6)≈5V, LD39200PU33R 3V3 LDO from +5V, the FCC(H753)/NAVC(F405) split with UART2+I2C+GPIO interconnects (R40-R51), the BMI088/IIS2MDCTR/MPRLS/TMP100/EEPROM sensor set, PCA9685, W25N01 FLASH, 24CW1280 EEPROMs, two CH330 bridges, TDD01H0SB1R boot switches and 25 MHz ABM8G crystals. The only apparent deviations are the barometer RESET/EOC swap (an explicitly logged known bug, not an anomaly), the empty Sensors sheet (documented), and the PCA9685 note of 0x41 (which is the correct value needed to avoid a bus clash with the INA219 at 0x40 on I2C2, i.e. a typo in the spec rather than a board fault). I could not find a drawing-supported deviation from the intended design, so no anomaly is reported.
